name: Westoverledingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Westoverledingen (a red wheel with pennants over waves on white).
history: Municipal flag of Westoverledingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Westoverledingen arms — wheel with pennants over waves
